assets.description: Decathlon blue et blanc logo, horizontal layout. Iconic sporting brand mark ideal for banner placement at top or bottom. Positioned on clean white background for maximum contrast and legibility.

Adventurer wearing orange puffer jacket and blue headlamp against dark background. Strong headlamp glow highlights night outdoor gear, perfect for rotation as hero image emphasizing illumination technology and cold-weather essentials.
Hiking boot in navy, blue et white colorway shown at three-quarter angle on white background. Professional packshot with clear product detail, rotatable as hero for footwear campaign focus.

Lightweight camping chair in black, displayed on wooden table overlooking mountain landscape and forest scenery. Lifestyle framing showcases portability and outdoor versatility—ideal hero image for camping essentials rotation.

Child in tent with sleeping bag (burgundy/red) and stuffed animal during evening camping. Warm, intimate lifestyle scene illustrating family camping experience. Strong emotional connection ideal for camping collection hero rotation.

Two hikers with backpacks (man in beige, woman in white/blue) posed in desert landscape with rocky formations and clear sky. Adventure-focused lifestyle shot showcasing hiking gear and outdoor confidence—strong hero rotation option.

Young male runner in neon yellow t-shirt jogging against urban brick wall backdrop. Dynamic action shot emphasizing running apparel and summer fitness activity. Perfect rotation hero for warm-weather running gear promotion.
